description_localkey:
The Nikke in charge of taste testing in Cooking Oil Squad.
When she eats food, she can discern its nutritional value, ingredients, and even subtle flavors.
She's also capable of gathering information about an item's components and fragments of memories tied to it just by tasting it.
However, she keeps this ability hidden as it could be exploited if discovered by the public.

character_costume_list.costume_description_locale:
Bready costume.
Obtained from an Event Pass.

squad_detail.squad_description:
A squad that collects, analyzes, and researches edible food from the surface.
Bready is responsible for tasting and analyzing hard-to-find food from the surface without waste, while Crust uses that data to research and recreate them.
Lately, they're focused on improving the quality of life of the Ark's citizens, by producing more diverse and delicious food using Splendamin.

character_dialog_group_list.speech_localkey:
Let me know if you're hungry.
I'll invite you to our kitchen.
Did you bring the food? Can I have some?
*Nibble nibble* Mmm, delicious.

Bonne Bouche, you look as scrumptious as ever.
May I have a bite later?

*Nibble nibble* What is it? Are you ticklish?
I still want to taste you some more, so please bear with me for a moment.

I know it's unfair that I'm always the one munching on you...
Would you like to try it too?
When are you getting back? I'm hungry.
I have to admit, waiting for you does make me appreciate the feeling of hunger a little more.
No one can come to our kitchen unless they are invited.
Do you have any tasty treats?

I'm gonna get something to eat.
Personally, I recommend the Maid Cafe.
I'm hungry. Have you got anything to eat, perchance?
I think my tongue has become more sensitive.
What a thrilling flavor! This is fun.
Interesting... I actually feel slightly full.
I'm curious what this will taste like.
Thanks. I'll eat it when I get hungry.
Anyone who gives me something to eat, like you, must be a good person.
Bonne Bouche, you're getting tastier with every passing day.
I want you to feed me the next item on the menu, Bonne Bouche.
Just looking at you is enough to make me feel full.
What's on the menu?
Did you call?
I found something that looks delicious.
The menu here is lacking.
This all looks rather unappetizing.
This barely even counts as a snack.
Let's finish up quickly and go eat something nice.
Just a moment, let me digest.
I'm really craving something tasty.
Refilling.
I'm famished!
I'll eat every last morsel!
Let's eat together!
One more plate.
Tasting finished.
Main dish finished.
Ouch.
Ugh...!
That hurts!
Urgh... Can't gather strength... too hungry...
That was a filling meal. What's next on the menu?
This ice cream is really hard—perfect for licking. *Lick*
Sweets don't make me full, but they do make me happy. Want a bite, Bonne Bouche?
I get sleepy if I have too much sugar. Wanna eat some ice cream and take a nap with me?
Can I spread this on your hand and taste it? I think it'll be really sweet.
I like dessert shops and all... but I like your room even better, Bonne Bouche.
Desserts are a treat for both the eyes and the palate. ...Just like Bonne Bouche.
I want something sweet, like ice cream, candy, chocolate, crepes...
I want something sweet, like Bonne Bouche, Bonne Bouche, Bonne Bouche, Bonne Bouche...
Do you know any good dessert shops?
I asked Crust to make me something sweet. Wanna come with?
Did you eat? How about dessert?
Bonne Bouche, let's go get something sweet together.
I feel stronger, like I just stuffed myself with good food.
Now I'll be able to taste you even better, Bonne Bouche.
My tongue feels all tingly now!
Ooh, thanks for the snack!
I wonder what this'll taste like with ice cream.
I hope this tastes sweet.
I've never tasted something this sweet before...
I like you so much, Bonne Bouche. Can I have just one little taste...?
Lately, you taste nothing but sweet to me. Is this what love tastes like...?
Okay, let's go!
Yes, Bonne Bouche?
There's something that looks sweet over here...
I wonder what they taste like.
I hope one of them is a new flavor...
That one might make a good entree.
Time for a little taste test!
I need to wipe my mouth.
I might be getting a food coma...
*Lick* This gun tastes bitter...
My tummy's grumbling.
So many sweets!
Time to dig in!
That one didn't taste good.
Next dish.
Is there any food left?
Ngh...
Ugh... My blood sugar's getting low...
I always have room for dessert. Let's go get something sweet.

attractive_scenario_list.scenario_title_locale: A Shared Meal, This Time for Real
